Data.RecruitPostName: 腾讯投资-Fund Investment Associate / Associate Director
Data.Responsibility:
1.Utilize proprietary and third-party data sources to conduct market analysis, investment research on global VC, PE and other alternative assets.
2.As a deal leader, ability to conduct due diligence, track record analysis, investment analysis report to support fund investment decisions.
3.Monitor GP performance by reviewing and analyzing quarterly reports and annual meeting materials.
4.Support or lead senior members on relationship management with worldwide leading GPs.
Data.Requirement:
1.Bachelor’s degree or master’s degree from world leading universities.
2.8-10 years of relevant experience in fund investment, private equity, investment banking in a leading firm.
3.Excellent research, analysis, financial modeling and valuation skills, due diligence experience. Past deal leading experience is preferred.
4.Exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and follow-through. Demonstrates ownership of tasks and team player.
5.Strong written and communication skills, both in Chinese and in English.
6.A high degree of professionalism and work integrity and positive attitude.
Data.Introduction: 加入腾讯战略与投资，你将与聪明的头脑一同共事，共同坚守企业社会价值。作为公司的决策大脑，我们在分析预判行业趋势与竞争动态的基础上，通过与业务部门的深度协作推动战略方案的落地。在这里，我们桥接时代前沿，诊断行业，提出洞见，共同实现科技向善。
